# LibreDWG (WebAssembly build)

From the npm package `@mlightcad/libredwg-web` 0.9.0 (https://github.com/mlightcad/libredwg-web),
a WebAssembly build of GNU LibreDWG (https://www.gnu.org/software/libredwg/).
Licensed under the GNU General Public License v3.0 (GPL-3.0). Used unmodified to convert DWG drawings to DXF in the browser.
